integrity: Self-contained proof, formulae and reproducible symbolic and finite-graph checker embedded; no external numerical data necessary.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous T_n graphs for n>=5; two equal positive absorbing rates; single-excitation adjacency dynamics; maximally mixed initial ensemble. Mean lifetime is conditional on capture; all-state unconditional lifetime diverges because of dark modes. Exact formulas and all-size inequalities have algebraic proofs; numerical checks are supplementary. Historical priority is provisional and independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp six-to-seven placement switch in two-absorber quantum capture on triangular graphs
